reason: A web search and page-fetch plugin for DeepSeek Harness that connects to multiple configurable providers, supports fallback and API-key management, and exposes native web_search and web_fetch tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供连接多个搜索与网页抓取服务的 Web 搜索插件，支持提供商切换、自动回退和原生搜索工具。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web search plugin that connects to multiple search and page-fetch providers with configurable ordering, fallback, and native search tools.

capabilities: Performs web searches through configured third-party or self-hosted providers
Fetches web page content through supported providers
Stores and uses user-configured provider API keys on the local DSH Host
Provides provider fallback, proxy configuration, quota display, and a settings interface
